facts.fact: Minister Amal El Fallah Seghrouchni said her ministry is preparing a digital bill, with the CNDP, DGSSI and ADD, covering algorithmic transparency, the right to explanation and contestation of automated decisions and non-discrimination in AI use, earlier planned for October and to be presented shortly.
